## updateKeyMetadata() function

Rename a stored key.

Only the fields of [KeyMetadataUpdate](./runtime.keymetadataupdate.md) can change. Revoking a key is [revokeKey()](./runtime.revokekey.md)<!-- -->; a key's permissions, expiry, creation time and prefix describe the issued token and never change.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function updateKeyMetadata(
  keyId: string,
  updates: KeyMetadataUpdate
): ApiKeyMetadata | undefined
```

## Exceptions

TypeError when `updates` holds anything other than a string `name`<!-- -->; nothing is written.
